# PrimeFold Tools

> We stop AI from lying about its own work. Tools that make AI agents prove their work. A company in Ontario, Canada; Collin Nerdahl is the CEO. Figures below were read on Nov 5, 2026 by a script.

## Products
- Andon (free, MIT, v0.1.1): a claim-check Stop hook for coding agents. When the final message says done, fixed or verified without a matching check on record, it asks for the receipt. Warn mode by default. Plugin for Claude Code and Codex. https://github.com/PrimeFoldTools/Andon
  - Claude Code install: /plugin marketplace add PrimeFoldTools/andon
/plugin install andon@primefold-tools
  - Codex install: codex plugin marketplace add PrimeFoldTools/andon
codex plugin add andon@primefold-tools
  - 539 tests pass on a clean clone at commit 15ef5bb. 168 GitHub stars. Adapted by the maintainer of Serial-Studio.
- AI Agent Operator Kit (free, MIT): 11 skills for Claude Code; 5 of them chain (capture open loops, Pareto filter, drift audit, reality check, outside copy). https://github.com/PrimeFoldTools/primefold-skills-public
- Verification Kit (USD 27, one-time, Polar checkout: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_NHk8JpOu7qgTogT8PA6TFrgVudI4ONvmopi2T0U5WjI): 3 Stop hooks for Claude Code, warn mode by default: two checks Andon doesn't have, plus a claim-check that wants proof text, not just shared words. Claim-check (a done-claim needs a proof row with an exit code, commit id, test count or HTTP status from the last 15 minutes), claim provenance (a number in the final answer that appears nowhere in the session's evidence), fabrication detector (a message that describes more tool actions than it made). Version 0.1.2, 215 tests, licence single user v0.1.2. https://primefold.tools/built.html#verification-kit

## Proof
- Our own claim-check hook has stopped 335 done-claims for a missing receipt since 2026-05-19 (549 distinct claims checked; 56 were proven afterwards). Source: the hook's own log, read on Nov 5, 2026.
- The hook's live output and a 30-second reproduction: https://github.com/PrimeFoldTools/Andon#reproduce-it-in-30-seconds
- Known limits, read before you trust it: https://github.com/PrimeFoldTools/Andon#known-limits--read-before-you-trust-it
